children: Grvt plans to launch Stable Funding Perps in November 2026, with liquidity sourced directly from traditional markets. Funding for the perpetual contracts is charged once a day.

Stable Funding Perps brings stocks, foreign exchange, commodities and indices onchain, expanding the range of markets available through Grvt. Trading in these markets could increase platform activity and provide indirect support for the GRVT token.

title: GRVT Token: Grvt launches Stable Funding Perps - Nov 2026
